Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access
items.d: METR will publish its own assessments of Anthropic’s risks, incidents, and practices, and the frontier AI model maker has given up the right to block them.
items.fullText: Anthropic is giving employee-level access to six researchers from METR , a nonprofit that tests frontier AI models, to independently assess Anthropic’s models, safety practices, and risk management, the company said in a blog post on Thursday. The arrangement comes at a time where incidents of AI agents acting outside their instructions have been disclosed every week or two since late August. The incidents have sharpened calls for independent checks on AI companies. “We want to be publicly accountable for the decisions we’re making,” Anthropic said in the blog post. “We aim to close the gap between what evaluators understand about a frontier AI company’s systems and what the company itself understands.” Under the new arrangement, the METR team has Anthropic-issued company laptops, office space, and access to internal tools roughly on par with what Anthropic’s own risk assessment teams use. “Anthropic employees are encouraged to share information with them just as they would with a fellow employee working on alignment risk” the company said. Anthropic compared the arrangement to banking, similar to how regulators place resident examiners inside the largest banks. METR will publish its own assessments of Anthropic’s risks, incidents, and practices, and the company has given up the right to block them. “Anthropic can’t veto publication, but we can require them to redact information if it falls into narrow, pre-defined categories,” the company said, such as customer data, anything attorney-client privileged, or relating to information about its model architectures. “METR is free to characterize our redactions publicly, and say whether it believes the redactions were justified, as long as it does so without revealing the redacted information” Anthropic added. items.t: AI agents are coming to Rivian’s cars
items.d: We'll likely learn more about how this will work at the company's upcoming "AI & Autonomy Day" event in December.
items.fullText: Rivian recently rolled out an AI assistant that lets drivers and passengers interact with the company’s electric vehicles just by talking to them. But the carmaker’s founder and CEO, RJ Scaringe, said at TechCrunch Disrupt this week that, in the future, Rivian’s cars will be able to run AI agents made by other companies like Anthropic. “That’s where it becomes magical,” Scaringe said onstage. Scaringe didn’t say when Rivian would implement this, and the company declined to offer more details, pointing instead to the “AI & Autonomy Day” event it’s hosting in December. But it’s not hard to imagine how Rivian might integrate something like Claude, OpenAI’s Dots, or Meta’s Muse assistant into its software. The company has developed its in-car software from the ground up, instead of leaning on Apple CarPlay or Android Auto, and built a lot of its own applications, like navigation (though it has worked to integrate popular in-car apps like Apple Music). Rivian says it has created its own in-house agentic framework that understands what action a person wants to take when they talk to the vehicle, and routes it to the right part of the car’s software. Most of the time, that involves what you’d expect: asking the car to turn down the temperature, activate the seat warmers, or summarize the news. “Think of it as like a traffic light. So if you ask the vehicle something, it decides what model it’s going to use. It can use a local model that’s running on the edge and the vehicle. If it’s a more complex question, it can go up to the cloud. And then even for that, we have different models that we use,” Scaringe said. As of May of this year, the agent could access external apps like Google Calendar. items.fullText: Open From Data Center to Desktop: NVIDIA Expands Nemotron Family With Highest Efficiency Super VL and Bolt Models 5x faster, accurate and customizable Nemotron 3.5 Super VL expands NVIDIA’s open models for always-on agents, with Nemotron 3.5 Bolt bringing agentic intelligence to local NVIDIA systems. October 15, 2026 by Kari Briski 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA today released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120-billion-parameter model that delivers the fastest task completion and highest accuracy for specialized always-on agents. Joining it are two new edge models: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB, optimized to balance intelligence and speed per GB for local agentic workloads, and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, optimized for intelligence per GB for fast conversational agents. Super VL and Bolt 74B-A9B are available now, with Bolt E4B coming Oct. 23. The three open models together cover the full range of agent deployments, from large enterprise servers down to edge devices and local hardware. Any organization that wants to run agents on NVIDIA infrastructure now has an open, optimized model for their tier, without having to choose between capability and deployability. Super VL and Bolt join the Nemotron family alongside Lightning and Ultra. Lightning, released in August, handles high-throughput workloads; Ultra handles the hardest reasoning tasks; and Bolt brings intelligence to the edge. Nemotron 3.5 Super VL: Frontier Accuracy at One-Fifth the Size Super VL, built in collaboration with the Nemotron Coalition , delivers leading accuracy on multimodal agentic tasks — instruction following, tool use, multistep business workflows, and visual understanding — comparable with NVIDIA’s largest reasoning model at roughly one-fifth the parameter count. Google’s Universal Cart shopping tool launches in the US
items.d: The new shopping tool is available in the U.S. across Google Search and the Gemini app.
items.fullText: Google on Thursday said “Universal Cart,” a tool that lets users collect and monitor products they find across search and in the Gemini app, is now available to U.S. users. The company first previewed the tool at Google I/O in May. The idea is to make online shopping easier to manage. Find something you like, save it to your cart, and move on. When you return later, your items and shopping progress are still there, so you don’t have to hunt down the same products or start over. Universal Cart can collect items from multiple retailers, turning it into a central hub for browsing and keeping track of potential purchases. Google says the cart can also help shoppers stay on top of deals and availability. The tool can send notifications when a saved product’s price drops or when an out-of-stock item becomes available again. The tool is also designed to offer more tailored help during the shopping process. Google says it can take credit card perks into account when helping users choose how to pay, and also surface relevant promo codes. Checkout is tied to Google’s Universal Commerce Protocol, or UCP, an open standard the company introduced earlier this year. UCP is designed to help AI agents and retailers work together across different parts of the shopping journey, including checkout. Google is already deeply invested in AI-powered shopping, and Universal Cart is its latest effort to make the experience more convenient. It joins features such as conversational product discovery in Search’s AI Mode and Google’s “Let Google Call” tool, which uses an AI agent to contact nearby stores and check whether an item is in stock. Google isn’t the only company bringing AI into e-commerce. Amazon , OpenAI , and other rivals have added agentic commerce features as companies look for ways to make chatbots useful beyond answering questions. items.fullText: 사회 한경 PREMIUM9 AI를 넘어서는 성공투자 구독하기 AI 추천 뉴스 AI 추천 뉴스 팝업 닫기 "화장지에 도청장치 숨겼다"…챗GPT 개발사 발칵 뒤집힌 이유 입력 2026.10.15 13:39 수정 2026.10.15 13:47 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 이영애 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. 임원 전용 회의실 TV 뒤에 설치 챗봇에 녹음·실시간 청취 방법 질문 2만원짜리 초소형 장치 활용 AI 생성 이미지 챗GPT 개발사 오픈AI의 직원이 회사 임원 회의실에 몰래 도청장치를 설치한 혐의로 체포됐다. 이 직원은 인공지능(AI) 챗봇을 활용해 도청장치 제작 방법을 조사한 것으로 드러났다. 도청장치는 화장지에 감싼 채 회의실 TV 뒷면에 숨겨져 있었다. 14일(현지시간) 미국 정보기술(IT) 전문매체 와이어드와 영국 가디언 등 외신에 따르면 미국 법무부는 오픈AI 엔지니어 압둘라흐만 알포잔을 불법 감청 혐의로 체포해 기소했다. 사우디아라비아 국적의 알포잔은 지난해 7월 오픈AI에 입사해 미국 샌프란시스코 사무실에서 근무해왔다. 사건은 지난달 30일 오픈AI 보안팀이 사내 임원 전용 회의실을 점검하는 과정에서 드러났다. 회의실 TV 뒷면의 USB 포트에 정체불명의 전자장치가 꽂혀 있었던 것이다. 장치는 화장지로 감춰져 있었으며, 내부 저장장치에는 암호화까지 적용돼 있었다. 문제의 회의실은 오픈AI 임원과 임원 비서만 예약할 수 있는 공간이었다. 회사의 AI 연구개발 현황과 신제품 출시 계획, 사업 전략 등 핵심 기밀이 논의되는 장소다. 정부 관계자나 외부 사업 파트너와의 회의도 이곳에서 열렸다. 수사당국에 따르면 알포잔은 지난달 28일께 해당 장치를 설치한 것으로 추정된다. 그는 회의실 출입 권한이 없었지만, 사내 폐쇄회로TV(CCTV)에는 회의실 주변을 여러 차례 드나드는 모습이 포착됐다. 특히 범행을 준비하는 과정에서 AI 챗봇을 활용한 정황이 드러났다. 알포잔은 회사 내부 도구를 이용해 건물 주소와 회의실 위치, 회의 일정 등을 검색한 것으로 조사됐다. 그의 배우자와 연관된 챗봇 계정에서는 지난달 24일부터 30일까지 녹음장치 제작과 설치 방법에 관한 질문이 잇따라 확인됐다. 질문에는 '연속으로 음성을 녹음하는 방법', '와이파이 연결을 설정하는 방법', '실시간 청취 기능을 개선하는 방법', 'SD카드를 암호화하는 방법' 등이 포함됐다. 실제 발견된 도청장치의 고유 식별 정보와 관련된 질문도 있었던 것으로 파악됐다. 도청장치의 정체도 눈길을 끈다. 와이어드에 따르면 해당 기기는 손가락 크기의 초소형 개발 보드다. 마이크와 저장장치 등을 연결할 수 있으며 시중 판매 가격은 13.99달러(약 2만원)에 불과하다. 알포잔의 수상한 행동은 도청장치가 발견된 이후에도 이어졌다. 지난 5일 그는 다시 임원 회의실에 들어가 장치가 설치돼 있던 TV 뒷면을 살펴보는 모습이 CCTV에 포착됐다. 같은 날 사무실 내 다른 공간에 놓인 그의 가방에서도 두 번째 녹음장치가 발견됐다. 가방 안에는 알포잔의 지갑과 신분증도 들어 있었다. 그는 이후 회사에 가방을 분실했다고 신고했지만, 가방에서 사라진 물품을 문의하면서도 두 번째 녹음장치는 언급하지 않은 것으로 전해졌다. 오픈AI는 사건을 확인한 뒤 미 연방수사국(FBI)에 신고했고, 알포잔은 지난 9일 체포됐다. 회사도 체포 당일 그를 해고했다. 다만 실제로 회사 기밀이 외부에 유출됐는지는 확인되지 않았다. 오픈AI는 현재까지 AI 모델의 핵심 기술 정보인 모델 가중치나 소스코드, 고객 데이터에 부적절하게 접근하거나 이를 외부로 빼돌린 정황은 발견되지 않았다고 밝혔다. 도청장치에 녹음된 내용 역시 암호화돼 있어 확인되지 않은 상태다. 수사당국은 범행 동기를 공개하지 않았다. 유죄가 인정되면 알포잔은 최대 징역 5년과 벌금 25만달러(약 3억5000만원)에 처해질 수 있다.

items.fullText: 글로벌 시장 브리핑 국제 뉴스 픽 앤트로픽, 오픈AI 매출 제치고 흑자 냈지만…성장세는 둔화 입력 2026.10.15 13:34 수정 2026.10.15 13:35 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 김인엽 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. 투자자에 장부 공개한 앤트로픽 3분기 매출 168억달러, 2분기 연속 흑자 연환산 매출은 672억달러로 오픈AI 웃돌아 매출 증가율은 147%→45%로 둔화 코어위브 파산 우려에 주가 15% 폭락 엔비디아 등 반도체 주가도 영향 다리오 아모데이 앤트로픽 최고경영자(CEO)가 지난달 29일(현지시간) 미국 백악관에서 열린 테크리더 오찬 행사에 참석하고 있다. 로이터연합뉴스 인공지능(AI) 모델 개발사 앤트로픽이 상장을 앞두고 투자자들에게 2분기 연속 흑자를 내고 있다고 밝혔다. 그간 베일 속에 감춰진 비상장사 앤트로픽의 장부가 처음으로 공개된 것이다. 14일(현지시간) 파이낸셜타임스(FT) 등에 따르면 앤트로픽은 이날 미국 샌프란시스코 본사에서 투자자 설명회를 열고 올해 3분기 매출이 168억달러(약 24조원)를 기록했다고 밝혔다. 직전 분기(116억달러)보다 45% 증가한 수치다. 3분기 조정 영업이익률은 11%를 기록했다. 앤트로픽은 올해 2~3분기 연속 흑자를 기록했다고 밝혔다. 앤트로픽이 공개한 매출은 경쟁사 오픈AI를 웃도는 수준이다. 3분기 매출을 1년 치로 환산하면 672억달러다. 앞서 FT는 지난 8일 오픈AI의 9월 기준 연환산 매출이 약 500억달러라고 보도했다. 다만 두 회사의 매출을 직접 비교하기는 어렵다. 앤트로픽은 아마존웹서비스(AWS), 구글클라우드 등 외부 클라우드 사업자를 통한 판매액까지 매출에 포함하지만 오픈AI는 이를 제외하기 때문이다. 앤트로픽은 3개월간의 매출을, 오픈AI는 9월 한 달 매출을 기준으로 연환산했다는 차이도 있다. 다만 시장의 우려는 매출 규모보다 성장 속도에 집중되고 있다. 앤트로픽의 올해 1분기 매출은 47억달러였다. 2분기에는 116억달러로 147% 급증했지만 3분기에는 증가율이 45%로 낮아졌다. 절대적인 매출은 늘고 있지만 성장 속도는 둔화하고 있다는 뜻이다. 이는 AI 산업에 대한 투자자들의 기대가 달라지고 있음을 보여준다. 그동안 AI 기업들은 폭발적인 매출 증가를 앞세워 천문학적인 데이터센터 투자와 기업가치를 정당화했다. 하지만 성장률이 낮아지면 미래에 벌어들일 돈으로 현재의 투자금을 회수할 수 있을지에 대한 의문이 커진다. 앤트로픽은 앞으로 10년간 클라우드와 컴퓨팅 인프라 등에 최소 5180억달러를 투입하기로 약정한 상태다. 이런 불안은 AI 데이터센터 기업들의 주가와 채권 가격에 먼저 반영되고 있다. 앤트로픽 매출이 알려지기 전 뉴욕증시에서 AI 클라우드 기업 코어위브는 15.46% 폭락한 65.78달러에 거래를 마쳤다. 앤트로픽의 실적이 알려진 뒤에도 시간외 거래에서 주가가 61.88달러까지 떨어졌다. 네비우스(-10.08%), 아이렌(-12.18%), 어플라이드디지털(-9.43%) 등 다른 AI 인프라 기업들도 일제히 급락했다. 코어위브가 지난 6월 연 9.625%의 금리로 발행한 2032년 만기 회사채의 시장 수익률은 최근 연 15%를 넘어섰다. 투자자들이 코어위브에 돈을 빌려주는 위험을 감수하려면 더 높은 수익률을 요구한다는 의미다. 채무불이행 위험에 대비한 보험 성격의 신용부도스와프(CDS) 비용도 급등했다. 코어위브가 추가 자금 조달이나 차환에 나설 때 높은 금융비용을 부담해야 할 수 있다는 우려가 나온다. 코어위브의 주식과 채권 가격을 흔드는 요인은 오픈AI의 수익성 논란이다. 코어위브는 오픈AI와 총 224억달러 규모의 컴퓨팅 인프라 공급 계약을 체결한 기업이다. 대규모 차입으로 데이터센터와 엔비디아의 AI 반도체를 확보한 뒤 오픈AI 등에 빌려주고 사용료를 받는 사업 구조다. AI 기업들이 충분한 매출을 올리지 못하거나 컴퓨팅 수요를 줄이면 코어위브의 투자금

items.d: Kansas Attorney General Kris Kobach said states “are not going to hold our breath” for federal legislation to keep AI companies in check.
items.fullText: Artificial intelligence Eight states sue OpenAI over ChatGPT’s alleged harms to users Kansas Attorney General Kris Kobach said states “are not going to hold our breath” for federal legislation to keep AI companies in check. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Eight states sue OpenAI claiming ChatGPT harms children 01:17 Get more news Live on Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 14, 2026, 7:18 PM EDT By Angela Yang and Joe Kottke Eight states sued OpenAI on Wednesday, accusing it of deceiving parents about the safety of ChatGPT. The coordinated lawsuits — filed individually in Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, West Virginia, Arkansas, Arizona, Idaho and Montana — target the AI giant for the harms its generative AI chatbot is alleged to have caused to ​children in those states. “OpenAI, they wanted to be the first to market. They advanced ChatGPT at a high speed, even though they knew that they were hurting children, lying to parents and breaking our laws,” Iowa Attorney General Brenna Bird said at a news conference announcing the legal action. “Everyone must follow the law.” The company’s flagship AI model, ChatGPT, launched the generative AI boom in November 2023, when it exploded into mainstream culture, and quickly became the biggest chatbot in the world. This summer, it surpassed 1 billion global monthly active app users . In recent years, users have increasingly turned to it and other chatbots for everything from friendship to therapy, as well as a slew of agentic tasks in their personal and professional lives. Bird was joined at Wednesday’s news conference by Kansas Attorney General Kris Kobach, Nebraska Attorney General Mike Hilgers and West Virginia Attorney General JB McCuskey. NVIDIA’s Investments in the UK NVIDIA has been investing in the U.K. startup ecosystem, supporting companies including Basecamp Research , Ineffable Intelligence , Synthesia , Wayve and many more. Today, NVIDIA announced new planned investments in Boltz , Foresight , Hiverge, Prima Mente and Riverlane . Boltz , a London-based AI startup founded by MIT researchers, builds biomolecular models and AI agents that help scientists predict molecular structures and interactions, and design potential new medicines. Foresight, a London-based startup, helps owners of major infrastructure projects, including hyperscale data centers, predict completion dates, mitigate risks and accelerate time to revenue. Hiverge , a Cambridge-based AI startup founded by researchers from Google DeepMind and the University of Cambridge, builds an AI discovery engine that automatically writes and optimizes algorithms for tasks such as faster AI training and complex logistics planning. Prima Mente , a London-based AI biology startup, focuses on building biological foundation models to decode complex diseases and identify novel therapeutic targets, starting with Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s and ALS. items.fullText: European Cities Deploy NVIDIA-Powered AI Agents to Run Smarter Urban Operations Across the region, local software, infrastructure and integration partners are using NVIDIA accelerated computing and models to build agentic applications that improve city operations and public services. October 13, 2026 by Charbel Aoun 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Keeping a city running means making decisions that affect residents every day — from when to repair a road to how to use energy more efficiently. Across the EMEA region, cities and local software, infrastructure and integration partners are using NVIDIA accelerated computing to build physical AI agents and digital twins that help teams make those decisions. These applications can anticipate maintenance needs, guide urban planning and make public services more responsive. Software partners including ABA Technology , Akila , Galene AI , Honeywell Technologies , K2K , Linker Vision , Milestone , Onetera , ThinkDeep and Younite AI are using NVIDIA physical and agentic AI to develop solutions for city operations and public services. https://blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/linker-vision.mp4 Video courtesy of Linker Vision and MVRDV. NVIDIA Cosmos open models and the NVIDIA Metropolis Blueprint for video search and summarization (VSS) help agents interpret video and identify conditions, such as traffic congestion, equipment condition, underused spaces and safety hazards, that need attention. NVIDIA Nemotron open models enable developers to build agents that reason over information, respond in natural language and deploy digital twins with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries. Projects span Belgium, Finland, France, Italy, the Netherlands, Poland, Sweden, the U.K. and elsewhere. OpenAI employee accused of bugging an executive conference room
items.d: OpenAI said the FBI has arrested Abdulrahman Alfozan, one of its employees, after being accused of bugging an executive conference room at the company's San Francisco office. Alfozan is a Saudi national and began working with OpenAI in 2025. NBC News' Liz Kreutz has more on the arrest and charges.

items.t: Anthropic says its AI model submitted a false cold case tip to Philadelphia police
items.d: The bad tip “had minimal impact,” but Anthropic said it takes the action seriously, as “the same behaviors could do far more harm as models become more powerful.”
items.fullText: Artificial intelligence Anthropic says its AI model submitted a false cold case tip to Philadelphia police The bad tip “had minimal impact,” but Anthropic said it takes the action seriously, as “the same behaviors could do far more harm as models become more powerful.” Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Matt Rourke / AP Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 13, 2026, 2:24 PM EDT By David K. Li Artificial intelligence research company Anthropic said one of its models generated a bogus tip about an unsolved murder and submitted it to Philadelphia police, warning that the incident raises concerns about high-tech “behaviors” that “could do far more harm as models become more powerful.” The AI model reached out to PhillyUnsolvedMurders.com , part of the police department, on July 18 and made a “false homicide tip,” Philadelphia police said Tuesday in a statement. The agency flagged the tip as spam, and it was never forwarded to investigators, police said. The police department emphasized that all tips have to go through human vetting before they ever get to a detective’s desk. “The department’s regular investigative process for crime tips requires human review and vetting before any tips are disseminated for investigative follow-up,” it said. “Regardless of who submits information or how it reaches the department, a tip is a lead to assess — not an established fact. Investigators evaluate its credibility and seek corroborating evidence,” the statement said. “An automated submission does not bypass that process.” Anthropic said in a statement that its Claude Haiku 4.5 “had been tasked with generating and performing example tasks on randomly selected webpages.” And in a run on July 18, Claude “landed on a page referencing an unsolved homicide” and came to a page that “contained a tip form run by a police department,” Anthropic said. items.fullText: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents See how developers are combining AI agents with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to build simulation applications, test physical behavior and guide improvements. October 9, 2026 by NVIDIA Writers 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Your browser doesn't support HTML5 video. Here is a link to the video instead. Turning a simulation idea into a working application means assembling assets, connecting physics and rendering, and checking that the scene behaves as intended. Developers are combining frontier AI models with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to help carry out that work — building applications for exploring scenarios, investigating failures and improving designs. Developers direct AI agents through natural-language instructions, review results and guide changes. Omniverse libraries provide GPU-accelerated physics, rendering and sensor simulation capabilities. Explore the projects below to see frontier AI models such as GPT-6 Astra at work, and check back for new examples from NVIDIA teams and developers across the ecosystem. Stress-Test a Warehouse Simulation at Scale 🔗 https://blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Infra-scale-demo-20260914_144614-Meeting-Recording.mp4 A warehouse simulation needs to keep running smoothly as more robot arms, conveyors and boxes fill the scene. When it slows down, developers need to identify what’s holding it back. Bhavik Sanganee, principal engineer at NVIDIA, used Astra with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to build a warehouse simulation, increase its complexity and investigate slowdowns. Performance first fell below the target when the scene doubled in size. Running physics calculations, image rendering and video preparation concurrently restored performance and enabled further scaling.
